join.zh:
您好，這裡是國泰航空桃園機場辦事處。

桃園機場安檢人員在 X 光檢查期間，發現您的寄艙行李內可能載有不可寄艙的物品。因此，需要請您在場一同進行開箱檢查，並視乎結果將有關物品改為手提或棄置。您的行李目前暫時留於辦理登機手續櫃位旁安檢處，尚未能安排裝載上機。

麻煩您盡快返回 4 號辦理登機手續櫃位，並與我們的職員聯絡。

如果您已通過手提行李保安檢查，但尚未通過出境檢查，請先向現場桃園機場工作人員說明情況，再返回確認您的寄艙行李。

請注意：如您未能返回辦理登機手續櫃位旁安檢處，而上述物品經確認不符合寄艙規定，有關物品將需要棄置。

如果您已通過出境檢查，請與 CX{flight_number}航班登機閘口國泰航空職員聯絡，我們會協助您跟進。

為確保您的行李能在航班起飛前完成檢查並安排裝載，麻煩您盡快返回或聯絡國泰航空職員，多謝您的理解及配合。
join.en:
Hello, this is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

Airport Security found an item in your baggage that cannot be checked in. Your baggage is currently being held at Check-in Counter 4 and cannot be sent for loading until the item is checked, removed for carry-on, or disposed of.

• Please return to Counter 4 as soon as possible and contact our staff.

• If you have passed security but not immigration, please inform airport staff and return to the check-in counter.

• If you have already passed immigration, please come to the CX{flight_number} boarding gate and contact our staff as soon as possible.

Please note that if you are unable to return to the security inspection area next to the check-in counter and the identified item is confirmed not to be permitted in checked baggage, the item will need to be disposed of.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

{cx flight/SEC/date}
join.ja: 【キャセイパシフィック航空】預け手荷物のX線再検査に立会いが必要です。出国審査前は至急4番カウンターへ。保安検査後・出国審査前は係員に申し出て4番へお戻りください。出国審査後はゲート係員にお申し出ください。お越しいただけない場合、荷物が搭載できない可能性があります。
join.routing: Chinese/English -> WhatsApp; Japanese -> native SMS. Japanese has no suffix.

transit.zh:
您好：這裡是國泰航空桃園機場辦公室。

由於您的寄艙行李未能通過桃園機場的轉機X 光安全檢查。因此，您的行李目前暫時留在
轉機行李檢查處，未能安排裝載上機。

為了確保您的行李可以在航班起飛前順利完成檢查並安排裝載，麻煩您盡快返回登機閘口聯繫國泰航空職員，我們會協助您跟進。

多謝您的理解和配合
transit.en:
Hello, this is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

Your checked baggage did not pass the transfer X-ray security screening and is currently being held at the screening area.

Please return to the boarding gate as soon as possible and contact our staff for assistance, so we can arrange for your baggage to be loaded before departure.

Thank you for your cooperation.
transit.ja: 【キャセイパシフィック航空】お預け手荷物は桃園空港の乗り継ぎX線検査で確認が必要です。至急搭乗ゲートのスタッフまでお申し出ください。
transit.routing: Chinese/English -> WhatsApp; Japanese -> native SMS. Japanese has no suffix.

structure.call_direct: Same call-only behavior as the former No message option; no message body.
structure.join_flight_rule: CX fixed; only approved general CX whitelist is accepted.
structure.transit_flight_rule: CX is fixed; only CX450, CX451, CX530, CX531, CX564, CX565 are accepted.
structure.transit_sec: Transit only: SEC 0–580; origin IATA is displayed below SEC.

join.zh: 您好：這裡是國泰航空，我們結束登機時間是起飛前 15 分鐘，您搭乘的{Flight}航班，目前已經在最後召集中，請您儘速前往 {Gate}號登機門。
join.en: Hello, this is Cathay Pacific. Boarding closes 15 minutes before departure. Your flight {Flight} is now on final call. Please proceed to Gate {Gate} as soon as possible.
join.ja: 【キャセイパシフィック航空】{Flight}便は最終搭乗案内中です。搭乗口は出発15分前に締め切ります。至急{Gate}番搭乗口へお越しください。
join.routing: Chinese/English -> WhatsApp; Japanese only -> native SMS. Japanese has no suffix.
join.ja_policy: User-approved 2026-09-23: tag-style opening; '搭乗締切は出発15分前です' (boarding closes 15 min before departure, matching the Chinese copy) keeps the SMS to 1 segment (66 chars).

transit.zh: 您好：這裡是國泰航空，您搭乘的台北往{DestinationZh}{Flight}航班，已經在最後召集中，請您儘速前往 {Gate}號登機門。您需要先通過轉機區隨身行李檢查，如果尚未通過請立即請最近機場人員協助，謝謝
transit.en: Hello, this is Cathay Pacific. Your flight {Flight} from Taipei to {DestinationEn} is now on final call. Please proceed to Gate {Gate} as soon as possible. You need to pass through the transfer security screening for carry-on baggage. If you have not yet done so, please ask the nearest airport staff for immediate assistance. Thank you.
transit.ja: 【キャセイパシフィック航空】{Flight}便（{OriginJa}発・台北経由{DestinationJaShort}行き）は{Gate}番搭乗口で最終案内中です。台湾の入国審査へは進まず、到着された方向へお戻りいただき、桃園空港の乗り継ぎ保安検査場で手荷物検査を受け、至急搭乗口へお越しください。現在の台北時間は{TaipeiTime}です。
transit.routing: Chinese/English -> WhatsApp; Japanese only -> native SMS. Japanese has no suffix.
transit.taipei_time: Only Transit Japanese includes current Taipei time using Asia/Taipei in 24-hour HH:mm format.
transit.ja_policy: User-approved 2026-09-23 (v1.10). Gate named in the first sentence. Many Japanese transit passengers walk toward Taiwan immigration by mistake, so the copy says not to enter immigration and to go back the way they came to the Taoyuan Airport transfer security checkpoint. No "Transfer" sign wording and no staff-fallback line (passengers who already entered Taiwan cannot make the flight). City names derived from the flight number (ja_route). Max 2 SMS (<=134).

scenario3_wrong_pickup.zh:
您好：

這是桃園機場國泰航空行李辦公室。

我們發現一件搭乘 {Arrival Flight} 抵達台北後無人領取的行李，該行李的行李牌號碼 {Bag Tag 1} 登記於您的名下。

目前另有一名旅客正在尋找一件外觀相似的行李。

請您協助確認您所領取的行李，其行李牌號碼是否為 {Bag Tag 2}？

您也可以直接拍攝您所領取行李的行李牌照片並傳送給我們確認。

為了避免耽誤您的行程，請您務必儘速聯絡我們，以確保您拿到的是正確的行李。

Email: tpe8bag@cathaypacific.com
Tel: +88627727630

謝謝您的配合。
scenario3_wrong_pickup.en:
Hello,

This is the Cathay Pacific Baggage Services Office at Taoyuan Airport.

We found one piece of unclaimed baggage from {Arrival Flight} arriving in Taipei. The baggage tag number {Bag Tag 1} is registered under your name.

Another passenger is currently looking for a similar bag.

Could you please confirm whether the baggage you collected has the baggage tag number {Bag Tag 2}?

You may also simply take a photo of the baggage tag on the bag you collected and send it to us for verification.

To avoid any disruption to your journey, please contact us as soon as possible so that we can ensure you have collected the correct baggage.

Email: tpe8bag@cathaypacific.com
Tel: +88627727630

Thank you for your cooperation.

To allow more time for your connection in Hong Kong, as any delay to your flight {Disrupted Flight} from Taiwan to Hong Kong may affect your onward flight {Connecting Flight}, we would be pleased to offer you the option of taking an earlier flight from Taiwan to Hong Kong — {Alternative Flight}, departing at {Alternative Departure Time}.

We are located at Counter 4, Terminal 1 of Taoyuan Airport. Please contact our staff at the counter directly when you arrive at the airport.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
